|reviews=* [[Jeff Hansen]], "Shoo! Shoo!", Neglected Card Series, [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] (2000). Hansen recommends the destiny 6 Interrupt against creatures such as [[Bubo]] and the [[Rancor]]: with a droid on table it cancels a creature's attack or moves an opponent's creature to an adjacent site. He notes that it keeps Bubo from eating Han or Leia in [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|Rescue The Princess]] and [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]] decks, and that moving a creature next to the opponent's characters can turn it against them. "All this and a destiny 6!"
